outgoing.name: China
outgoing.excerpt: The giant panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca, "black-and-white cat-foot"; Chinese: 大熊貓) is a mammal classified in the bear family, Ursidae, native to central-western and southwestern China.

outgoing.name: Chinese language
outgoing.excerpt: The Chinese language name for the giant panda, 大熊貓, literally translates to "large bear cat", or just "bear cat" (熊貓).

outgoing.name: Coin
outgoing.excerpt: Its image appears on a large number of modern Chinese commemorative silver, gold, and platinum coins.
